changelog:
- Initial release of the *loadpage* skill (version 1.0.0).
- Provides text humanization capabilities using the comprehensive AI-writing pattern removal workflow described in SKILL.md.
- Detects and fixes common AI writing traits, such as exaggerated symbolism, promotional phrasing, vague attributions, and superficial "-ing" analyses.
- Adds guidance for improving tonal variety and injecting personality to make text more natural and human-like.
summary:
Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Use when editing or reviewing
text to make it sound more natural and human-written. Based on Wikipedia's
comprehensive "Signs of AI writing" guide. Detects and fixes patterns including:
inflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague
attributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, negative
parallelisms, and excessive conjunctive phrases.
